required_operations: Unique Key bulk insert and sequence revision
Three voting FEs and RF3 tablet topology
consistency: Completed fixture readback; no serializable multi-statement guarantee claimed. Fixed-replica reads disable caches, missing-version skips and fixed-replica fallback.
atomicity: One bulk INSERT at a time. Lost mutation acknowledgements remain ambiguous until reconciled.
idempotency: Unique Key(order_id), sequence revision. Conflicting concurrent writers and replay histories remain pending.
delete_ttl: Only explicit database teardown is covered; deletes/retention pending.
durability: Three tablet replicas on three BE containers and three FE voters, all on one physical host. No independent backup, disk failure or host-loss qualification.
retry: No application mutation retry. FE has native query retries; the first immediate outage query still failed after about 41 seconds. Preserve that failed result.

reference_client.verification: Dedicated connection for session settings and row stream

fault_expectations.backend-restart: Strict immediate read must succeed; initial attempt FAILED. Fault cleanup restores retained BE without resetting data.
fault_expectations.backend-recovery: Follow-up characterization: hold one BE down; allow transport errors, require a new exact-body read within 90 seconds, then retained restart and complete three-replica verification. This does not turn the strict failed attempt into a pass.

payload: 1,000,000 fixed four-integer rows, 10,000 customers, 8 tablets and 3 copies per tablet.
